 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. HOBART, Australia (AP) — England won the toss Wednesday and decided to bat in the third and deciding one-day cricket international at Bellerive Oval.
 England evened the series with a 135-run win Sunday in Adelaide after Australia won the opener in Perth, Western Australia, by seven wickets.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Looks like a good surface and hopefully we can put a nice big score on the board and put them under pressure. We're on a high. It was a great game in Adelaide," England captain Harry Brook said.
 Australia captain Mitchell Marsh said the home side, which made two changes, would have batted first.
 Mahli Beardman, who took six wickets on debut in the first ODI match, and Alex Carey came into the side for Riley Meredith and Adam Zampa.
 ___
 Lineups:
 Australia: Travis Head, Mitchell Marsh (captain), Matt Renshaw, Josh Inglis, Alex Carey, Cameron Green, Cooper Connolly, Jack Edwards, Xavier Bartlett, Spencer Johnson, Mahli Beardman
 England: Ben Duckett, Tom Banton, Joe Root, Harry Brook (captain), Jordan Cox, Will Jacks, Sam Curran, Liam Dawson, Sonny Baker, Gus Atkinson, Jofra Archer.
